function: The <audio> tag is used to embed sound content in a document, such as music or other audio streams.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.function: Specifies that the audio will start playing as soon as it is ready

attributes.name: controls
attributes.function: Specifies that audio controls should be displayed (such as a play/pause button etc)

attributes.name: loop
attributes.function: Specifies that the audio will start over again, every time it is finished

attributes.name: muted
attributes.function: Specifies that the audio output should be muted

attributes.name: preload
attributes.function: Specifies if and how the author thinks the audio should be loaded when the page loads

attributes.name: src
attributes.function: Specifies the URL of the audio file
